senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) [trimmed chip,] door-bolt, pin fitting into sockets top and bottom.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 101a:7">B. Bath. 101ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>דעביד להו כמין נ׳</he> he made the sepulchral chambers like an upright bolt, i.e. placed the bodies in an upright position.

<cite ref="Menachot 33a:5">Men. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>עשאה כמין נ׳</he> if he fastened the door-post inscription (<cite ref="M00730"><he>מזוזה</he></cite>) so as to look like a bolt shoved into a case, i.e. horizontally.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:12:3">Y. Meg. IV, end, 75ᶜ</cite> <he>בית מזוזתו … כמין נ׳</he> the case for the inscription in Rabbi’s house was made like an upright bolt (reaching the top of the door).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15">Num. R. s. 15</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 32:2">Yalk. Josh. 32</cite> <he>יריחי היתה נְגָרָהּ וכ׳</he> (not <he>נגרא</he>) Jericho was the bolt of Palestine; a. fr.
